Manual install (if install.bat did not work)
============================================

Close the game completely first.

The game folder (GAME below), usually:
  C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Call to Arms - Gates of Hell
If you don't know where it is: Steam -> right click the game -> Manage -> Browse local files.


1. Files into GAME\binaries\x64
------------------------------
  a) Find xvidcore.dll there (the game's file, about 1 MB) and rename it to xvidcore_orig.dll.
     Don't delete it: the replay fix needs it.
  b) Copy three files from the "files" folder of this archive there:
       files\iphlpapi.dll       - the mod itself
       files\xvidcore.dll       - the replay fix (about 64 KB)
       files\goh_snapshots.ini  - turns on instant replay seeking
     If Windows asks about replacing, say yes.

2. If you had my replay_unlock mod before
-----------------------------------------
  It is not needed any more (the Replays tab is in iphlpapi.dll now):
  delete the folder GAME\mods\replay_unlock and turn it off in the game's Mods menu.

3. Check
--------
  Start the game. The mod asks about the online list and offers to sign in through Steam.
  Multiplayer -> Internet: the PVP button and the global chat above the friends.
  Bottom left in the menus: "Official build, latest version".
  Keys: Shift+F6 - online, Shift+F7 - competitive, Shift+F8 - replay panel, Shift+F9 - charts.
  If the game does not start: delete iphlpapi.dll from GAME\binaries\x64 and send
  GAME\binaries\x64\goh_replay.log.


Manual removal
==============
  1. Delete iphlpapi.dll, goh_snapshots.ini, goh_online.ini and xvidcore.dll from GAME\binaries\x64,
     then rename xvidcore_orig.dll back to xvidcore.dll.
     You can delete the rest the mod made too: goh_*.ini, goh_*.log, goh_balance_profile_*.bin.
  2. If after a game update a big (about 1 MB) xvidcore.dll is in binaries\x64, keep it and just delete
     xvidcore_orig.dll.
  The key Documents\My Games\gates of hell\goh_mod_key.txt can stay: you need it if you come back.
